title: [ingest] suggest_links duplicate threshold is 0.6 label/summary overlap
summary: SUGGEST_DUP_THRESHOLD = 0.6: a new task scoring >=0.6 token-overlap against an OPEN non-note task is flagged as a likely re-plan duplicate. This is the specific cutoff behind 'never create a duplicate of an open task'.
